title: Flatsmonster Inshore Fishing
specs: Target species include redfish, snook, tarpon, mangrove snapper, Spanish mackerel, and trout
Fishing techniques include live bait under floats, free-lining, chumming, and plug casting
Fishing locations include inlets, bridges, jetties, sand shoals, grass flats, beaches, and docks
Snook permit required for snook fishing

services.name: Fishing Report
services.desc: Reports from the boat - where the fish are holding, what they are eating, and which tide to fish. Written by Capt. Tyson. Fall snook season is open. Current size and bag limits, where the fish are holding, and what else is worth targeting around the passes this month. Bait is thick in the Intracoastal and the low tide before sunrise is the best two hours of the day. Where to be, what to throw, and when to quit. Deep holes hold the biggest fish of the year, the bridge shadow lines fish well after dark, and recent rain has the trout and redfish switched back

includes: Live bait caught prior to pick up
blurb: Guests fish for species like redfish, snook, tarpon, mangrove snapper, Spanish mackerel, and trout inshore and nearshore waters. Trips include use of all fishing equipment, tackle, flies, artificial lures, and live bait caught prior to pick up. Fishing techniques include live bait under floats, free-lining, chumming, and plug casting around structures and flats.
